src_sentence: varyāgītikoṣaḥ [1] prajñāpāramitārthāmṛtapānaparipuṣṭā hi kukkuripādāḥ tamevārthamātmani bhagavatīnairātmā- yoginīmadhimucya vadanti | hā~u nirāsī ityādi | ahaṃ bhagavatī nairātmā nirāśīḥ āsaṃgarahitā | khamaṇeti sarvaśunyaṃ manaḥ svāmī| asya suratābhiṣvaṅge na mama viśiṣṭasaṃyogākṣarasustānubhavaḥ kasminnapi kathāvedyo na bhavatīti | tathā ca sarahapādāḥ - ko patijbai kāsu kahami ajja kar̤āibha āu | piyadaṃsaṇe ileṇa ṭalesi saṃsāra phur̤a jāu ||16 [śru] dhruvapadena tamevārthaṃ draḍhayati phiṭale ityādi | ataeva antamiti paryantaḥ | mahāsukhacakrasvakuṭīṃ dṛṣṭrā sphuṭamiti viṣayādivṛndaṃ mayā nairātmayā tasmin samaye niṣkṛntitaṃ| svayamevātmānaṃ saṃbodhya vadati | bho mātanairātme tadidānīṃ yaṃ yaṃ viṣayāriṃ paśyāmyatra sa ko 'pi na vidyate | sarveṣāṃ mahāsukhamayatvāt || [2]

head: duḥkha
target: lhan cig tu byas nas kye'i byis pa'i rnal 'byor pas bla ma'i drin la yul dang dbang po nye bar longs spyod par gyis shig pa'o/ / 'di'i thabs kyis thams cad bla na med par gyur pa grub pa'i slob dpon dA ri ka'i zhabs kyis so/ / 'khor ba la rang dang pha rol dang gzhan gyi cha shas dang dbye ba ma mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /
